sentences.en: Because, one, JF is the person who badgered me into joining Twitter or coming and, like, actively participating in Twitter, as he did for most of the C++ committee.
sentences.zh: 因为，第一，JF 是那个软磨硬泡让我加入推特，或者说积极参与推特的人，就像他对大多数 C++ 委员会成员做的那样。

sentences.en: Like, JF, like, created C++ Twitter for anybody who doesn't know.
sentences.zh: JF 几乎是为所有不知道的人创建了“C++ 推特圈”。

sentences.en: So, he brought me there.
sentences.zh: 所以，是他把我带进来的。

sentences.en: And I came to Twitter after him.
sentences.zh: 我是在他之后才来到推特的。

sentences.en: But now I have more followers because I clearly am just far more likable and charismatic and good-looking and all these other things than JF.
sentences.zh: 但现在我的粉丝比他多，因为我显然比 JF 更讨人喜欢、更有魅力、长得更帅，还有其他所有方面。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I actually passed him over the summer, but I knew I couldn't say anything about it immediately because if I did,
sentences.zh: 没错，其实我在夏天就超过他了，但我知道我不能立刻说出来，因为如果我说了，

sentences.en: Hana and JF would immediately organize some sort of campaign to unfollow Bryce to deflate my very, very oversized ego.
sentences.zh: Hana 和 JF 会立刻组织某种取消关注 Bryce 的运动，来打击我那非常、非常膨胀的自我。

sentences.en: And they would have been completely justified in doing so.
sentences.zh: 而且他们这样做完全是有正当理由的。

sentences.en: But I was like, no, I need to be far enough ahead of him that when I tweet about it, it is challenging for him to reverse the situation.
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，不，我需要领先他足够多，这样当我发推特炫耀时，他很难扭转局面。

sentences.en: And so, like, there were, you know, at one point I was as many as, like, 200 or 300 followers ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 所以，有一次我领先了他多达 200 或 300 个粉丝。

sentences.en: And then, like, you know, he'd tweet something great because, like, he's much better at tweeting than me.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，他会发一些很棒的内容，因为他比我更擅长发推特。

sentences.en: I don't know why I have more followers than him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我的粉丝比他多。

sentences.en: Like, he's way funnier, much better content.
sentences.zh: 他比我有趣多了，内容也更好。

sentences.en: But, you know, he'd post something really good and then, like, he'd catch up.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，他会发一些非常好的东西，然后就会追上来。

sentences.en: And then, like, you know, I'd post something, like, you know, pretty good.
sentences.zh: 然后，我也会发一些，你知道，还不错的东西。

sentences.en: And then, like, I'd pull ahead again.
sentences.zh: 然后我又会领先。

sentences.en: So it was, like, back and forth.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样来来回回。

sentences.en: Like, there were points where he got, like, as close as, like, being under 100 again.
sentences.zh: 有几次他甚至追到只差不到 100 人了。

sentences.en: But I was finally like, you know, okay, I'm not going to really, you know, get really far out ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 但我最终想，好吧，我不会真的领先他太多。

sentences.en: So I'm just going to wait until I hit 10,000 before him.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算等到我先达到 1 万粉丝再说。

sentences.en: And then, you know, that'll be good enough.
sentences.zh: 那样就足够了。

sentences.en: And, I mean, I should mention this.
sentences.zh: 而且，我应该提一下。

sentences.en: This is a little unfair to JF because, one, JF just moved internationally.
sentences.zh: 这对 JF 有点不公平，因为第一，JF 刚搬到国外。

sentences.en: And, two, JF has two small children.
sentences.zh: 第二，JF 有两个年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: So he does not have as much time to shitpost on Twitter as, you know, say I do.
sentences.zh: 所以他没有像我这样有那么多时间在推特上发废话。

sentences.en: Although he does manage to get an impressive amount in.
sentences.zh: 尽管他还是设法发了相当多令人印象深刻的内容。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I have more than 10,000 followers on Twitter.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 你还没说你的账号名呢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 另外，我也意识到我们聊得太圈内了。

sentences.en: So do you want to explain who JF Bastion is and who Hannah Dusakova are?
sentences.zh: 所以你想解释一下 JF Bastion 和 Hana Dusakova 是谁吗？

sentences.en: Like, there's a, I'm sure there's a Swift developer.
sentences.zh: 比如，我肯定有 Swift 开发者在听。

sentences.zh: 我该怎么解释 JF 是谁呢？

sentences.en: So, Jay, I am the library evolution chair on the committee, on the C++ committee.
sentences.zh: JF 是委员会的库演进主席，C++ 委员会的。

sentences.en: And JF is the language evolution chair.
sentences.zh: 而 JF 是语言演进主席。

sentences.en: But our friendship goes back far longer than that.
sentences.zh: 但我们的友谊要追溯到很久以前。

sentences.en: I've known him since about 2016 or so.
sentences.zh: 我大约 2016 年左右就认识他了。

sentences.en: When I first joined the committee, I became very good friends with JF and Olivier.
sentences.zh: 我刚加入委员会时，和 JF 以及 Olivier 成为了非常好的朋友。

sentences.en: I first came to the committee to mostly go to the concurrency and parallelism study group, which is where, at the time, they spent most of their time.
sentences.zh: 我最初加入委员会主要是为了参加并发与并行研究小组，那是他们当时花时间最多的地方。

sentences.en: And now you have to introduce who Olivier is.
sentences.zh: 现在你得介绍一下 Olivier 是谁了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错，没错。

sentences.en: I'm getting there.
sentences.zh: 我正要说。

sentences.en: I'm getting there.
sentences.zh: 我正要说。

sentences.en: I'm getting there.
sentences.zh: 我正要说。

sentences.en: And so the three of us sat in the back of the concurrency study group, which is called SG1, together.
sentences.zh: 我们三个人一起坐在并发研究小组（即 SG1）的后排。

sentences.en: And we were just instantly thick as thieves.
sentences.zh: 我们立刻就成了无话不谈的好友。

sentences.en: Now, Olivier and JF have known each other since they were in college, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 奥利维耶（Olivier）和 JF 至少从大学起就认识了。

sentences.en: They're both French Canadians.
sentences.zh: 他们都是法裔加拿大人。

sentences.en: They both went to some of the same schools.
sentences.zh: 他们上过一些相同的学校。

sentences.en: And they had been on the committee together before me longer.
sentences.zh: 而且他们加入委员会的时间都比我早。

sentences.en: But we were just like, we were a little band.
sentences.zh: 但我们当时就像一个小团体一样。

sentences.en: And it's funny because, like, at that time, we spent about a year or two where it was just the three of us.
sentences.zh: 说来有趣，那时我们有大概一两年的时间，只有我们三个人。

sentences.en: We were just regular committee members.
sentences.zh: 我们只是普通的委员会成员。

sentences.en: And we spent most of our time in SG1.
sentences.zh: 大部分时间都在 SG1 工作组。

sentences.en: And now today, Olivier is the chair of SG1, the concurrency group.
sentences.zh: 如今，奥利维耶是 SG1 并发工作组的主席。

sentences.en: JF is the chair of the language evolution group.
sentences.zh: JF 是语言演进工作组的主席。

sentences.en: And so we never actually spend time together on the committee anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上再也没有机会在委员会里一起共事了。

sentences.en: And I, you know, Olivier works at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，奥利维耶在英伟达工作。

sentences.en: I also work at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 我也在英伟达工作。
